observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the noun mobil means an engine-driven land vehicle with four or more wheels; oto and otomobil are listed. It also records a separate adjective sense meaning movable. This supports the claim that the dictionary definition is broader than passenger cars, including four-wheeled vehicles.
observations.limitations: Establishes the recorded dictionary sense, not the full range of actual usage.

observations.source_title: Menhub: Mobil diproyeksikan dominasi angkutan Lebaran 2026
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the report uses mobil pribadi for a private passenger car and distinguishes it from sepeda motor, bus, and kereta api. This supports the passenger-car application of mobil in Indonesian transport reporting.
observations.limitations: One news report provides contextual usage, not a comprehensive usage survey.

observations.source_title: Menhub: Mobil diproyeksikan dominasi angkutan Lebaran 2026
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the report uses mobil pribadi for private passenger cars in a national transport context, distinguishing it from motorcycles, buses, and trains. This supports mobil as a natural term in contemporary Indonesian transport reporting, but only on limited contextual evidence.
observations.limitations: A single report supports contextual naturalness but does not establish broad everyday preference.

observations.source_title: Survei Potensi Pergerakan Masyarakat Angkutan Lebaran 2025
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the ministry repeatedly uses mobil pribadi as a travel-mode category, distinguished from bus, kereta api, and sepeda motor. This supports the term in formal transport usage.
observations.limitations: An official survey category supports formal transport usage; it does not alone establish everyday conversational preference.

observations.observation: The recorded inspection says Kamus Dewan marks the vehicle sense of mobil as IB (Indonesian) and glosses it as motokar, kereta; Kamus Pelajar also defines the vehicle sense and gives kereta. This supports the dictionary gloss of mobil as kereta or motokar.
observations.limitations: The entry explicitly marks mobil as Indonesian; a dictionary gloss establishes a sense or translation, not Malaysian everyday preference.

observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the vehicle sense of mobil is marked IB (Indonesian) and glossed as motokar, kereta. This establishes a contrast in the dictionary entry but does not directly show which term Malaysian speakers prefer in ordinary usage.
observations.limitations: The inspection explicitly cautions that the dictionary entry establishes existence, not everyday preference.

observations.observation: The recorded inspection says MABBIM maps Indonesian mobil pribadi to Malaysian kereta persendirian and Indonesian pemilikan mobil to Malaysian pemilikan kereta. This supports the comparative terminology contrast between the varieties, but the inspection warns that such term comparisons alone are insufficient to establish ordinary conversational preference.
observations.limitations: Terminology comparisons do not by themselves demonstrate everyday preference.

observations.source_title: Pemandu Maut, Penumpang Cedera Kereta Terbakar Di NPE
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says a contemporary Malaysian report repeatedly uses kereta for Toyota Vios or Corolla Altis passenger cars and refers to the driver and passenger. This supports kereta as contextual usage for passenger cars in Malaysian news.
observations.limitations: One report supports contextual use, but does not establish the frequency of preference across everyday speech.

observations.observation: The recorded inspection says the ministry uses Kereta dan Motosikal Persendirian for road-tax categories, distinct from motorcycles and commercial vehicles. This supports kereta as an official Malaysian transport category for cars.
observations.limitations: Official category wording is evidence of institutional usage, not by itself a broad measure of everyday conversational preference.

observations.source_title: Menhub: Mobil diproyeksikan dominasi angkutan Lebaran 2026
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says Indonesian reporting uses mobil pribadi for passenger cars, distinct from other travel modes. This supports the Indonesian side of the claimed variety comparison.
observations.limitations: Supports only the Indonesian side; one report does not establish common usage across all contexts.

observations.source_title: Pemandu Maut, Penumpang Cedera Kereta Terbakar Di NPE
observations.observation: The recorded inspection says Malaysian reporting repeatedly uses kereta for a Toyota Vios or Corolla Altis passenger car. This supports the Malaysian side of the claimed variety comparison.
